Vehicle Taxation System using Multilevel Inheritance

Problem Statement:
Implement a multilevel inheritance structure to calculate vehicle tax.

Description:
Base class: Vehicle (price)
Derived class: Car (adds fuelType)
Derived class from Car: ElectricCar (adds batteryCapacity)

Requirements:
1. Tax = 10% of price.
2. Electric cars get 50% tax discount.
3. Use constructor chaining.
4. Prevent direct instantiation of intermediate class.
5. Demonstrate runtime object behavior.

Input Format:
Vehicle price
Fuel type
Battery capacity

Output Format:
Final tax amount.
